posts.author: sirmalaketh
posts.body: Hello fellow RM's,  I recently bought RMMZ and i'm excited to use it. However, (big pause for effect) when i try to work on the second tutorial the bubble that tells you what to do is all the way at the bottom of the screen and i cannot move it or hit next. I have tried resizing the screen, tried a combination of different commands all to no avail. is there a way to be able to move the bubble without moving the tutorial screen? I tried moving the tutorial screen as well.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to MZ!
I can't specifically help, but I vaguely recall having a couple problems while trying to complete the tutorial. I think I might have had to skip something.
However, what I can say is that I found tutorial series that I found on YouTube to be more helpful than the built in tutorial.
There are lots of tutorial series that go from basic to advanced topics.
If you search for RPG Maker MZ tutorials on YouTube you will find quite a few choices. That is how I started really learning. I looked for content creators that had entire series and then just selected some to go through.
I recommend recreating what you watch instead of just watching the videos.
Anyway, sorry I can't answer your specific question. Good luck!

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body: Your monitor resolution seems to be correct, but the scale to be at 125%, which often affects various software because devs are often not expecting it. However, in your case, I believe you have changed the size of the texts, they are much larger than I remember.
